observations: Photo 0 shows a retail box for a Nikon D750 and a smaller box for a Nikkor 50mm lens.
Photo 1 shows the D750 box open with user manuals in English and French.
Photo 2 shows the interior of the box with two large items wrapped in bubble wrap.
The camera body, lens, battery, and charger are not visible outside of their packaging in any photo.

claims.evidence: Only the retail box and manuals are visible; the camera body itself is not shown.
The items are wrapped in bubble wrap, preventing any assessment of physical condition.
There are no photos of the camera powered on or showing the rear LCD.
No screenshot or photo of a shutter count report is provided.

claims.claim: no fungus or scratch on the lens
claims.evidence: The lens is not visible in the photos.
These accessories are not shown in the photos.

risks.risk: The box may not contain the described items or may contain different models.
risks.proof: Photos of the camera body and lens outside of the bubble wrap.

risks.risk: The camera sensor or lens glass may be scratched or have fungus.
risks.proof: Clear, close-up photos of the sensor and the front/rear lens elements.

risks.risk: The shutter may have a much higher count than claimed, affecting longevity.
risks.proof: A screenshot of the shutter count from a recent RAW file.

risks.risk: The camera may have electronic faults or not power on.
risks.proof: A video of the camera powering on, focusing, and taking a photo.

proof_requests: Photos of the camera body from all angles (front, back, top, bottom, sides) outside the bubble wrap.
Photos of the lens (front and rear glass) outside the bubble wrap.
A photo of the camera's rear screen while powered on.
A screenshot or photo showing the actual shutter count.
Photos of the battery and charger.
response.reason: The seller has only photographed the packaging and manuals. The actual camera and lens are hidden inside bubble wrap, making it impossible to verify their existence, model, or condition.
